integrity: The lower bound follows from a pointwise quadratic-versus-linear bound on each side of the mean plus endpoint-mass constraints. The upper bound is a binary-indicator Cauchy--Schwarz inequality at the mean cut. Equality conditions and explicit collapse sequences give the exact attainable sets. Exact-rational computation replays finite cases but is not used as a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for finite discrete laws with fixed positive atom probabilities and variable ordered support locations.
Except for the two-point case and the three-point lower endpoint, the sharp boundary constants are not attained by distinct supports.
The originality search was targeted and may miss an equivalent theorem in older finite-population or deviation-inequality literature.

title: Exact fixed-profile range of mean absolute deviation over standard deviation
